system: Lo2 durable feedback / USL conflict diagnostics
requirements: Lo2 only learns from verified LAW/JUDGE output with provenance and anti-poison traceability.
Logic/ledger failure must remain FAILED/fail-closed and must not become a successful learning result.
Safe failure identity must be preserved for investigation.

packages/lo2/engine.ts.why: QuantumConflictError had no code property, so the dispatcher could reduce this typed USL conflict path to LO2_FEEDBACK_PROCESSING_FAILED.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.spec_requirement: Keep the learning failure fail-closed while exposing a safe stable diagnostic identity.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.old_behavior: QuantumConflictError exposed existing/challenger IDs but no safe code.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.new_behavior: QuantumConflictError exposes code LO2_QUANTUM_CONFLICT; conflict handling/resolution semantics are unchanged.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.security_impact: Only a fixed allow-listed code is exposed; raw IDs/details are not added to feedback output.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.determinism_impact: No authoritative state, ordering, tick or conflict winner change.
packages/lo2/engine.ts.test_impact: Static contract asserts the stable code is present; the full contract suite exercises the changed source.

tests/contract/lo2-durable-anchor.test.t.why: The typed error identity needs a source-level regression guard.
tests/contract/lo2-durable-anchor.test.t.spec_requirement: Failure diagnostics remain stable and safe.
tests/contract/lo2-durable-anchor.test.t.old_behavior: No contract assertion for a stable QuantumConflictError code.
tests/contract/lo2-durable-anchor.test.t.new_behavior: Contract asserts both declaration and assignment of LO2_QUANTUM_CONFLICT.
tests/contract/lo2-durable-anchor.test.t.security_impact: No raw diagnostic content is asserted or emitted.

proven_gap: Code inspection proved QuantumConflictError lacked the safe code expected by failureCode.

Exact-head runtime after the fix still emitted generic Lo2 failure, proving that this known typed conflict was not the runtime error class exposed by the current browser run; no root cause was inferred.
